research_boundary.known_contamination: The historical PPOSM 2024-2026H1 windows have been exposed by prior research. This experiment is research-only and cannot authorize deployment.

source.prompt_boundary: signal-time numeric state and causal symbolic predicates only

architecture.name: pairwise_residual_action_router
architecture.label_rule: SWITCH iff candidate exact base-cost utility is strictly greater than TP4 utility; ties KEEP
architecture.route_rule: Start at TP4. Switch only when SWITCH-minus-KEEP mean candidate-logprob margin is strictly above the frozen global train threshold. If both candidates qualify, select the larger raw margin; exact ties use SKIP before TP12.

rlvr.reward: exact-format reward plus clipped selected residual utility

train_only_threshold_freeze.score: mean log probability over label tokens plus EOS; margin = SWITCH minus KEEP
train_only_threshold_freeze.grid: all distinct pre-2024 margins plus sentinels immediately below the minimum and above the maximum
train_only_threshold_freeze.objective: maximize the sum of selected per-signal residual utilities under the exact deterministic route rule
train_only_threshold_freeze.feasibility: at least 10 percent pre-2024 non-default routes, at least 10 observations for every used non-default route, and no action above 90 percent
train_only_threshold_freeze.no_feasible_threshold: freeze above the maximum margin, retain TP4 everywhere, and record a failed experiment without OOS repair

stopping_rule: Evaluate exactly this frozen adapter, decoding rule, and train-selected threshold once on the full report/veto windows. Do not change architecture, hyperparameters, threshold, or decoding after OOS scoring.
